name: Himawari no Chapel de Kimi to
original_name: ひまわりのチャペルできみと
source:
School days... Full of hope... You fall in love with a girl, and go forward to the future together... It's a slapstick love comedy story! 

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
校园生活……充满希望……你爱上一名女孩，与她携手走向未来……这是一个热闹欢腾的爱情喜剧故事！

[摘自ErogeShop]
